body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2009') -- <Visual News> BenQ's mobile projector 'GP1' was displayed at the TI booth during CES 2009, enabling users to easily run movies, pictures, and office applications directly from a USB thumb drive without the need for notebook attachment.
The GP1 will be available March 2009 through the BenQ e-store and other channels for $599.
< AVING Special Report Team for 'CES 2009' : Idea Kim, Min Choi, Kevin Choi, Joshua Shim, Paul Shin, Miso Kim, Esther Yoon, Abraham Shim, Grace Won, Risa Koo, JB Shim, Jini Shim >
